info.name: Hotel Booking API - Comprehensive Journey Collection
info.description: Complete end-to-end API collection and journey scenarios for the Hotel Booking Application (package com.hbooking). Includes Onboarding, Search/Discovery, Happy Path Booking & Card Payment, Alternative Payments & Idempotency, Payment Failure & Inventory Recovery, Tiered Cancellations, and Robust Edge Case/Validation error handling.
